notes: Anything that gets a roll waits in chat until its roll lands: rare drops, sea creature, slayer, Diana and Scatha drops, catches, gifts, and Nucleus, corpse and treasure loot
The ▬▬▬ line above a rolled loot message waits too
Messages are held back only after other mods have seen them, so SkyHanni and Skyblocker trackers still count them
Corpse rolls leave out HOTM Exp as well as powder
Gemstone names no longer keep the symbol in front of them
